title: Provable Cross-Modal Transfer of Hierarchical Concept Structure in CLIP Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.17671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP are trained to align images and text, not to represent taxonomies. Yet empirical studies show that CLIP embeddings exhibit hierarchical structure aligned with the hierarchy of semantic concepts. A theoretical characterization of why such hierarchy emerges from a non-hierarchical objective remains open. In this paper, we formalize this phenomenon as Hierarchical Angular Separation (HAS), a geometric property whereby each non-leaf concept embedding is more similar to its descendants than to off-branch concepts. Empirically, we show that HAS holds approximately in raw images and randomly initialized CLIP image embeddings, while in text embeddings it holds approximately only after contrastive learning. translated_title: CLIP嵌入中层级概念结构的可证明跨模态迁移
translated_abstract: 诸如CLIP这样的对比式视觉-语言模型是为了对齐图像和文本而训练的，而非为了表示分类体系。然而实证研究表明，CLIP嵌入展现出与语义概念层级相一致的层级结构。关于这种层级结构为何会从非层级性目标中产生，其理论刻画仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们将这一现象形式化为层级角分离（Hierarchical Angular Separation, HAS），这是一种几何性质，即每个非叶节点概念嵌入与其后代概念的相似度高于其与分支外概念的相似度。在实证方面，我们证明HAS在原始图像和随机初始化的CLIP图像嵌入中即近似成立，而文本嵌入只有在经过对比学习后才近似满足HAS。为了从理论上解释这种不对称性，我们分析了一个无约束特征模型，其中图像嵌入固定不变，仅对文本嵌入进行训练。在全局最小值处……
tldr: 本文首次从理论上刻画了CLIP嵌入中层级概念结构的跨模态迁移现象，提出层级角分离（HAS）的几何性质作为形式化定义，并证明了图像嵌入天然具有的层级结构可在对比学习中被迁移至文本嵌入。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical characterization of cross-modal transfer of hierarchical concept structure in CLIP embeddings, formalizing it as Hierarchical Angular Separation (HAS) and proving that hierarchy naturally present in image embeddings is transferred to text embeddings through contrastive learning.
